title: Taste of Korean Coffee and Well-being Tea Event flyer
alt: In celebration of International Education Week, the Korean Program and CGE are delighted to invite you to our annual “Taste of Korean Coffee & Well-Being Tea” event on both the Dahlonega and Gainesville campuses. Not a coffee lover? We will also offer a delightful selection of traditional Korean teas, perfect for keeping you warm and cozy as the weather gets colder.
